sonnet.problem: The card says 'the LORD says' a nation has invaded 'His land.' Verse 6 ('My land') doesn't name who is speaking, so the card guesses a speaker.
sonnet.rule: When the text doesn't say who is speaking, he doesn't guess. He uses a plain lead-in, like "Then the psalm says…", and names a speaker only when the passage or its heading does.

sonnet.problem: The statement nearly repeats card 13, which already told that the herds wander in confusion. It is an easy True that gives the baker nothing to reason out.
sonnet.rule: A True statement never just repeats the card before it.

sonnet.problem: The card says Joel 'turns and calls out to the LORD Himself.' The 'I' of verse 19 ('To You, O LORD, I call') is not named in the passage, yet the card assigns it to Joel. Cards 16 and 17 repeat this with 'Joel tells the LORD' and 'In his prayer, Joel says.'
